title: Quantile Propagation Planning for Budgeted Tail-Risk Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Risk-aware planning must identify rare, costly outcomes using only a limited number of model evaluations. Monte Carlo rollouts spend this budget on noisy tail estimates, while planning from the mean can miss the tail entirely. We introduce quantile propagation planning (QPP), which propagates a small, fixed set of disturbance quantiles through the dynamics and integrates the resulting cost curve to evaluate both mean and tail risk. The method is exact at the propagated levels, converges as the quantile grid is refined, and admits a one-sided conservatism guarantee under stated structural conditions. In controlled overload and inventory tasks, QPP reduces realized tail cost and constraint violations relative to mean-rollout planning. On overload, it remains competitive with sampled evaluators that use substantially more trajectories. These results position QPP as a transparent, budget-controlled approach to tail-risk evaluation.

translated_title: 面向预算受限尾部风险评估的分位数传播规划
translated_abstract: 风险感知规划必须仅利用有限次数的模型评估来识别罕见且代价高昂的结果。蒙特卡洛滚动模拟会将这一预算耗费在带有噪声的尾部估计上，而基于均值的规划则可能完全忽略尾部风险。我们提出了分位数传播规划（QPP），该方法将一小组固定的扰动分位数通过系统动力学进行传播，并对由此得到的成本曲线进行积分，从而同时评估均值风险与尾部风险。该方法在所传播的分位数水平上是精确的，随着分位数网格的细化而收敛，并且在给定结构条件下具有单侧保守性保证。在受控的过载与库存任务中，与基于均值的滚动规划相比，QPP 降低了实际的尾部成本和约束违反。在过载任务中，QPP 与使用多得多的轨迹的采样式评估方法相比仍具有竞争力。这些结果表明，QPP 是一种透明且预算可控的尾部风险评估方法。
tldr: 提出分位数传播规划（QPP），通过传播少量固定扰动分位数并积分所得成本曲线，在有限模型评估预算下同时精确评估均值与尾部风险，相比均值滚动规划显著降低尾部成本与约束违反。
en_tdlr: Quantile Propagation Planning (QPP) propagates a small fixed set of disturbance quantiles through the dynamics and integrates the resulting cost curve, enabling transparent, budget-controlled evaluation of both mean and tail risk while reducing tail costs and constraint violations compared to mean-rollout planning.
